description: Autocomplete active canonical places by prefix, optionally resolving historical context for a date.

date.description: Optional historical date in yyyy-MM-dd format; names and context are resolved as known on that date.

query.description: Required beginning of a place name, as typed so far.

take.description: Optional number of suggestions to return, from 1 through 20. Defaults to 10.

typeCode.description: Optional canonical place type code (see the place-type-catalog resource).

name: autocomplete_places
